title: REPORT on the implementation of the EU Youth Strategy 2019-2027
part_text: 36. Highlights that young people are disproportionately affected by the housing crisis, which limits their access to affordable and quality housing; underlines that this negatively impacts their employment opportunities, mobility and social inclusion; calls on the Commission and the Member States to support affordable and sustainable housing solutions for young people, including students, and stresses that housing should be one of the key pillars of the post-2027 EUYS; ; calls on the Commission and the Member States to implement measures designed, in particular through the ESF, to guarantee the right to decent, affordable and high-quality housing for all, particularly for vulnerable people and young people, notably through the development of social and public housing, rent control, the prevention of evictions and the fight against homelessness.
